title: Listing Description Generation with Fair-Housing Checks

blueprintSignals.name: Fact match rate
blueprintSignals.definition: share of claims in the description that equal a field in the record
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Match on meaning and not on string, because the same fact is worded many ways

blueprintSignals.name: Prohibited phrase score
blueprintSignals.definition: classifier probability that a sentence steers by a protected characteristic
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Needs labelled examples from complaints and must be reviewed by counsel

blueprintSignals.name: Agent edit rate
blueprintSignals.definition: share of generated words that the agent changed before publishing
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Edits reflect habit as well as quality, so read it by agent

blueprintSignals.name: Coverage
blueprintSignals.definition: share of the record's key features such as beds, parking and outdoor space that appear
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Depends on what the agent considers key, so weight by market

engineFeatures.meaning: narrow queries for context and evidence, with no free-form shell or query language
the specific records that justify a verdict
text fields an outsider can influence, treated as data

maximum tool calls before the agent must stop or escalate

label: For "Listing Description Generation with Fair-Housing Checks": Draft accurate listing descriptions from structured facts and photos and block language that could breach fair-housing rules. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Training on past listings copies the biased language those listings contain.
